metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a runnable Node.js (stdlib-only) CLI simulator at `output/main.js` plus supporting modules in `output/`:
- Parses RS274 real values (numbers, `#` parameters, `[...]` expressions, unary ops), comments, block delete (`/`), tool table files, and parameter files.
- Tracks machine state + modals and supports basic execution for `G0/G1/G2/G3`, `G4`, `G10 L2`, `G17/18/19`, `G20/21`, `G28/G30`, `G38.2` (with optional `--probe-box/--probe-tool`), `G40/41/42` (state only), `G43/G49`, `G53`, `G54–G59.3`, `G90/91`, `G92*`, `G93/94`, `M3/4/5`, `M6`, `M7/8/9`, `M48/49`, `M2/M30` reset effects.
- Writes final-state JSON to `--output` on both success/error; writes `--trace-output` with stepping via `--trace-time-step`, `--trace-distance-step`, or `--trace-position-tolerance`.

Run format:
`node output/main.js --input program.ngc --output out.json [--trace-output trace.json --trace-time-step 0.1 ...]`

Known gaps vs `docs/RS274NGC.md` + `docs/Clarifications.md`:
- Full canned cycles `G81–G89` expansion + required trace semantics for their sub-motions (including `motion_kind` labeling) are not implemented.
- Full cutter radius compensation geometry per Appendix B (including clarified arc semantics under CRC) is not implemented.
